Container.Name: diun
Container.Overview: Docker Image Update Notifier is a CLI application written in Go and delivered as a Docker image to receive notifications when a Docker image is updated on a Docker registry.
Container.DonateText: Contribute upstream first. But if you like our work, consider donating.
Container.Requires:
Add notification variables as needed. Ex.
DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_WEBHOOKURL DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_WEBHOOKURLFILE DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_MENTIONS (comma separated) DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_RENDEREMBEDS DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_RENDERFIELDS DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_TIMEOUT DIUN_NOTIF_DISCORD_TEMPLATEBODY
If you are using a Docker socket proxy, delete the `/var/run/docker.sock` volume mapping, and add an environment variable for `DIUN_PROVIDERS_DOCKER_ENDPOINT` = `tcp://dockersocket:2375`

Config.Name: DIUN_DB_PATH
Config.Description: Contains bbolt database which retains Docker images manifests

Config.Name: DIUN_PROVIDERS_DOCKER_WATCHBYDEFAULT
Config.Description: Optional: Set to true to watch all containers

Config.Name: DIUN_PROVIDERS_DOCKER_WATCHSTOPPED
Config.Description: Optional: Set to true to watch stopped containers

Config.Name: DIUN_PROVIDERS_DOCKER_ENDPOINT
Config.Description: Note: Set to `tcp://dockersocket:2375` if you are using a proxy

Config.Name: DUIN_DOCKER_SOCKET
Config.Description: Note: Remove if you are using a proxy
